records.title:
AFFORDABLE RENTAL HOUSING AND GENDER INCLUSION IN URBAN 
DEVELOPMENT
details:
based on the proposals submitted by 
States/Union Territories (UTs) under Model 2, MoHUA has approved proposals for construction 
of 83,298 new ARHC units. Out of total approved units, 40,630 ARHC units have been 
completed.

records.title: Newly Built International Airports
details: One greenfield airport in Uttar Pradesh i.e. Noida (Jewar) is under development. The probable date of completion of first phase of the project is by September, 2024. Under the RCS UDAN scheme, 12 airports namely, Aligarh, Chitrakoot, Ayodhaya, Gazipur, Jhansi, Moradabad, Meeraut, Muirpur, Azamgarh, Shravasti, Saharanpur and Fursatganj are proposed to be developed in the state of Uttar Pradesh. Out of these, development of 5 airports namely, Aligarh, Azamgarh, Chitrakoot, Moradabad & Shravasti have been completed and airport licensing work is in progress. Development work w.r.t. remaining seven airports is ongoing with Probable Date of Completion by March, 2024.
